profile_text.body:
Greylock Partners is a venture capital firm based in Silicon Valley, according to its own site. It describes itself as a leading venture capital firm and as an early partner to teams building companies that matter. The firm says each of its partners makes only one or two new investments a year because the work demands depth, and that it brings its full attention, network, and resources to every partnership. Its site also quotes the view that a Greylock partner should aspire to win the Oscar for the best supporting actor, a reputation it says must be earned every day.

The firm was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California, in the United States, and it operates on a for-profit basis. No AI products or MCP servers are associated with it, and no lawsuits involving the firm are listed.
